notes.title: Another Beta Down!
notes.notes:
📣 Attention Trouble Makers! 📣

The Trouble Makers Beta has officially come to an end. 🎭 A huge THANK YOU to everyone who joined in the chaos, smashed their way through the madness, and helped us test the mayhem! 💥 Your feedback and participation mean the world to us.

But don’t worry—the trouble doesn’t stop here! Stay tuned for updates, news, and the announcement of the next beta times. There’s plenty more mischief to come, and we can’t wait to see you back in the fray.

💡 Follow us for updates and be the first to know when the next round of trouble begins!

👉 Until next time, stay troublesome! 👈

notes.title: Trouble Makers Beta Today!
notes.notes:
🚨 Attention Trouble Makers! 🚨

The Trouble Makers Beta goes LIVE today, January 4th, from 12 PM to 2 PM PST! 🎉

Get ready to cause chaos, unleash mayhem, and test your mettle in the ultimate showdown of trouble. Don’t miss your chance to dive into the beta and experience the madness firsthand!

⚠️ Remember: This is your time to shine (and smash), so join us, bring your A-game, and let the trouble begin!

👉 See you there, troublemakers! 👈

notes.title: Next Beta! Jan 4th, 2025
notes.notes:
Greetings, Troublemakers!

We’re excited to announce the next beta test for Trouble Makers! Mark your calendars for January 4, 2025, as we dive into a hyper-focused testing session. The beta will run from 12 PM to 2 PM PST, and we need your help to make this session a success.

This test is all about testing our network and lobby systems. Your feedback during this focused session will be instrumental in shaping the future of Trouble Makers.

Get ready to jump back into the action, cause some chaos, and help us refine the experience! More details on how to join and what to expect will be shared soon.

We can’t wait to see you there!

– The Trouble Makers Team

notes.title: The end of beta....for now.
notes.notes:
Greetings, Trouble Makers!

As the current beta phase comes to an end, we want to thank each of you for your time, effort, and feedback. While we’ve made progress, we must be honest—the test didn’t go entirely as planned. We had  a lot of players...unfortunately players were not all trying to play at the same time. That's on us and next time we will make sure players can make trouble together! 

We’re taking this time to address these issues, refine the systems, and prepare for another beta phase in the future. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re committed to learning from it and coming back stronger.

Stay tuned for updates on when the next beta will launch. With your continued support, we’re confident we’ll create some trouble together.

Thank you for being part of this hiccup!

– Pickle, Trouble Makers SM

notes.title: Trouble Makers Beta!
notes.notes:
Get Ready to Raise Some Havoc in the TROUBLE MAKERS Beta – December 13–15!

Dust off your neon tracksuits and crank up the synthwave—it's time to dive into the wildest, most chaotic battle you've ever experienced! TROUBLE MAKERS is the first and only BATTLE SURVIVOR where causing mayhem isn't just allowed—it's the whole game!

Join epic 4-player free-for-all showdowns where anything goes. Unleash boobie sasquatches to trip up your foes, become some ghost-busting knockoff to spook the competition, or summon reverse mermaids (fins on top, legs on the bottom—trust us, it's a splash!). Team up with a fuzzy little devil, outwit that mysterious emo kid, or charm your way past a sly serial heartbreaker.

The more you play, the more totally rad rewards you earn! Unlock skins, titles, borders, and backgrounds that'll make you stand out in the crowd—all your rewards carries over when the full game launches.

So what are you waiting for? Mark your calendars for December 13–15 and join the TROUBLE MAKERS beta. It's gonna be a blast—from the past!

Cause chaos. Survive the madness. Become a TROUBLE MAKER!
